module: Flowgraph node "SpotLight" (repeat_instant, author BeamNG). Creates a SpotLight object (worldEditorCppApi.createObject) and updates it. Inputs: update (flow), clear (impulse), position, rotation, range (20), innerAngle (15), outerAngle (45), color, brightness (1). Outputs: created (impulse), lastId. data.maxObjectCount (1) limits the number of objects.
notes: The name built in createObject is never used (no registerObject).
The color pin must contain 4 components, otherwise the concatenation fails.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

init.desc: Initializes the object list and data.maxObjectCount = 1.

createObject.desc: Creates the light with the pin values (canSave = false), adds it to the list, writes lastId and notifies the editor.

objectName.desc: unused (the computed name is not applied)

work.desc: On clear, deletes; otherwise creates the light if the maximum is not reached (created = true) and, with update, updates it (position, rotation, angles, brightness, range, color).

onClientEndMission.desc: End-of-mission hook: cleans up the objects created by the node.

destroy.desc: Called when the node is destroyed: cleans up the created objects.
